name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_alloc_text_buffer
description: HudUiNumericTextInput::AllocTextBuffer forwards the requested size to the embedded HudUiTextInput buffer allocator.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiNumericTextInput source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b4e40 validates adding 0x14c to this, pushing bufferSize, calling HudUiTextInput::AllocTextBuffer, and returning.

Native smoke zhud_numeric_text_input_base_constructor_smoke verifies AllocTextBuffer(8) replaces the embedded text buffer, updates capacity to 8, preserves the existing '42' prefix, and GetBuffer returns the embedded buffer pointer.
